model: SimBiology insulindemo (Cobelli / Dalla Man 2007 meal model), variants from the example
band_rule: p10/p90 = pointwise min/max over Vmx x {0.8, 1.0, 1.2} (insulin sensitivity +/-20%); p50 = nominal
summary_rule: auc = incremental AUC above basal 0-240 min; t_baseline = first time after the peak within 5 mg/dL of basal (240 if never)

variant_rule.source: ADA Standards of Care 2024, Table 2.2; variants from the SimBiology insulindemo example
variant_rule.label: a typical curve for someone with your fasting glucose and weight

walk_calibration.mechanism: Vm0 (insulin-independent glucose utilisation) x factor during the walk, decaying afterwards with the stated half-life (assumption)

labels.curve: a typical curve for someone with your fasting glucose and weight
labels.walk: plus a 30 min walk starting 15 min after eating
